market_summary: Pre-NY overlap conditions show broad consolidation across metals, FX, and crypto. XAUUSD and BTCUSD remain structurally bearish below their session VWAPs and Value Areas but lack volume confirmation to chase breakdowns into session lows. EURUSD is trapped in mean-reversion chop inside its Value Area around VWAP.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (3957.75) and below POC (3978.28). CVD is BEARISH (-5.02) with negative slope (-1.18), agreeing with the downtrend. However, in LONDON_SESSION, price is consolidating near the lower ATR band (3932.65) and well below VWAP (3968.15) and EMA50 (3961.10). There is no recent RVOL > 2.0 confirmation (rvol_last 1.099, 47 bars since spike). The forming bar shows a bounce off 3934.70 toward 3940.39, putting price mid-range between Session Low 3924.30 and EMA20 baseline 3946.66. Without fresh breakdown volume or a clean retest of resistance, setup lacks momentum edge.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of lower consolidation above Session Low 3924.30

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10793 to VAH 1.10983) and below POC (1.10943). CVD is NEUTRAL (-321.42) with a steep negative short-term slope (-4838.03), conflicting with choppy price action. In LONDON_SESSION, price is closely tracking VWAP (1.10866) and EMA50 (1.10892) mid-ATR channel, testing Prev Low at 1.10824. RVOL is modest at 1.184 (last spike 3 bars ago). Being inside Value Area favors mean-reversion chop toward POC without a directional breakout trigger.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: acceptance inside Value Area near Prev Low support 1.10824

signals.rationale: Price is operating below VAL (73295.04) and far below POC (73518.45). CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) with negative slope (-0.01), aligned with the bearish trend below VWAP (73484.26) and EMA50 (73408.67). In LONDON_SESSION, price is hovering right on the lower ATR band (72721.93) and probing Session Low (72639.70). However, RVOL shows no yellow expansion spikes (0 spikes, rvol_last 1.247) to validate a fresh breakdown, and selling directly into the Session Low without a clean break or retest risks a bear trap.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sustained below descending VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: test of Session Low support at 72639.70
